versionDescription: c0.24-dev is the first developer build for Classic 0.24_SURVIVAL_TEST known as 'Minecraft Resources Text'. It was shown on Notch's YouTube channel on August 4th, 2009.
additions:
Breaking blocks now allows the player to pick up and place them, adding or removing them from hotbar.
- There is no limit for the stack size, but one type of block can only be in one slot.
One-block deep lava layer was added at the bottom of the map at Y=1
changes: <social> Sky color has been changed from #7FCCFF to #99CCFF.
<spec> Removed the ability to spawn mobs by pressing G.
fixes: Sand and gravel now properly fall through liquids.
bugs: Placing blocks at build height consumes them in the hotbar without being placed.
Middle-clicking on a block A while holding a stack of some other block B replaces that block B in hotbar with the targeted block A while retaining it's quantity.
media: <remakescreenshot> Lava sea at Y=1. Lava blocks can be removed using sand or gravel.
trivia: Currently the number 1 in stacks of 1 block is rendered. This gets changed in c0.24-dev5.
While the full release is labeled '0.24_SURVIVAL_TEST', all of its developer builds are labeled just '0.24'.
